capabilities: Request user approvals via interactive buttons.
Securely store bot tokens using Environment Keys.
extras: Features strict security controls, including rate limiting and quiet hours, and uses a 100% native Obsidian UI.
intentEvidence: Telegram AI Gateway is an Obsidian plugin that enables AI agents (Claude Code, Antigravity) and automation scripts to send rich notifications and interactive approval requests with inline buttons to Telegram
problem: AI agents and automation scripts require a secure, structured way to communicate with users and receive interactive decisions outside of the Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Claude Code's AskUserQuestion hook can use these tools to send its questions to Telegram.

summary: A gateway allowing AI agents and automation scripts to send rich notifications and interactive approval requests to Telegram using secure, local routing.
